name: SQLBot
description: ChatBI system that answers business questions by generating SQL with an LLM plus retrieval, with workspaces and permissions.
whatItDoes: Lets business users ask questions of company databases in plain language and get query results and charts. Administrators manage data sources, workspaces and access rules.
howItWorks: A web service combines an LLM with retrieval over schema and terminology to produce SQL, and bundles its own PostgreSQL. It can be embedded in other applications and is callable by other agents over MCP on a second port.

requirements.name: LLM endpoint
requirements.description: Model configured in the admin UI
